issues.description: The GET endpoint for retrieving all persons is inconsistent between the template and the solution: the template's PersonResource maps the endpoint to "/persons" while the solution maps it to "/people". This divergence is structural (different request path) and can confuse students when they compare their template-based implementation, tests, or documentation with the reference solution. It may lead to hard-to-find differences when trying to call or test the 'get all persons' endpoint.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the GET mapping consistent between template and solution. Either change the solution to use @GetMapping("persons") or change the template/tests to use @GetMapping("people") and update any references in the tests and documentation accordingly so both template and solution use the same path for the 'get all persons' endpoint.

issues.description: The endpoint path used for retrieving all persons is named inconsistently: the template and the exercise instructions consistently refer to the resource path 'persons' (e.g. PUT /persons/{personId}/parents), but the solution's PersonResource maps the getAll endpoint to 'people' (@GetMapping("people")). This creates a conceptual mapping barrier: students expect 'persons' from the problem statement and template, yet the solution exposes 'people', which may confuse students when locating or testing the corresponding endpoint.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the resource path naming across all artifacts. Prefer using 'persons' for the collection endpoint in the solution (change @GetMapping("people") to @GetMapping("persons")) so it matches the template, tests, and the problem statement; or alternatively update the problem statement and template to consistently use 'people' if that naming is preferred.
